conversionDecisions: Keep the approved prototype immutable; its pending approval annotations describe its generation-time state. Explicit subsequent user approval is recorded here and in state.json.
Preserve approved 640/960/1280px desktop-first rules rather than translating breakpoints and risking fidelity.
Section metadata Id supplies the original industries/news/company anchors; only the prose assistant uses a Style value.
All ten captured industry panels are authored server-side. The prototype only renders one at a time, so round-trip EXTRA panels/images are intentional, not invented content.

Brand-home link is local. Four source-root referrals remain deliberately external: Account/location, privacy choices, cookie preferences and the captured Window Films destination. The source-owned services were not migrated; the generic localizer reports these four exceptions and must not rewrite them to an inert local homepage.

The bundled EW harness used older bare-link/button-container behavior. Its ignored local runtime mimic was corrected to the inspected scripts.js formatted-only/button-wrapper contract; no application behavior was changed to satisfy the probe.

The installed default Node20 cannot run the repository's existing Stylelint18. Restore pinned dependencies with npm ci, then run npm run lint through isolated Node24.15.0; do not alter project dependency versions.
